answer: As the decentralized network hummed along, its copper wires buzzing with activity, a new user tried to flood the inlet of the system with fake identities, hoping to exploit its generosity. To prevent this, the network employed a mechanism where each identity was required to demonstrate a unique work trail, verified through a random audit sample, effectively creating a ridge of trustworthiness that separated genuine users from sybil attackers, and making it costly for the latter to maintain their fake identities.
